versions.subject: Rule: Vssadmin / NTDS.dit activity
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine:
        # Ransomware
        - 'vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows'
        # Hacking 
        - 'vssadmin create shadow /for=C:'
        - 'copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\*\windows\ntds\ntds.dit'
        - 'vssadmin delete shadows /for=C:'
        - 'reg SAVE HKLM\SYSTEM '
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 CommandLine IN ("vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows", "vssadmin create shadow /for=C:", "copy \\*\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\*\\windows\\ntds\\ntds.dit", "vssadmin delete shadows /for=C:", "reg SAVE HKLM\\SYSTEM ")
